Blinkit · Ads · unified format

Does Blinkit fit our unified store?

Yes. Every Blinkit Ads sheet maps into the existing tables without new columns. What stops it loading today are mapping, seed-data and two small code fixes, listed below. Measured by running our real mapping code in memory over 7 month-to-date workbooks and 44 one-day exports; nothing was written to the database.

Fits the schema 5 fixes before loading Research · 15 Oct 2026

The verdict

Fits as is

  • Daily dates, ad type per sheet, keyword and category breakdowns
  • Bid-level rows summed to one row
  • Direct / indirect split
  • Reach, unique clicks, bids and budgets kept, never summed
  • Restated days as new versions

Needs configuration

  • Product Recommendation: point its sub-campaign at the ad group (YAML)
  • Brand selector = Manufacturer name
  • Seed ad-type groups, headline, control rule, availability
  • Restatement window 5 → 10 days
  • Accept Match Type NA / SMART (code)

Open question

  • One manufacturer, several of our brands (Q21): today one Blinkit login means one brand
  • No clicks or orders: CTR, CPC and cost per order show “not available for Blinkit”

The same fields as Zepto; nothing new is needed.

Gaps between the design and what would run

G1Product Recommendation can't be loaded

Its sub-campaign columns have no place in our loader, so the sheet stops in every file. Fix (tested): map Subcampaign ID → ad group ID and Asset → ad group name. YAML only.

G2The brand check fails on every file

The Blinkit connections have no brand selector. Setting it to the Manufacturer name passes; merge the two Del Monte brand records first (Q21).

G3Two ad-type vocabularies, no groups

Daily sheets say Keyword/Category Targeting; the MTD sheet says Product Booster. wh.dim_ad_product is empty: seed the house groups.

G4Headline and control rule not seeded

No Blinkit rows in wh.headline_sources or wh.reconciliation_rules. The ±₹1 control holds 95–100% once Product Recommendation loads.

G5Metric availability not seeded

Clicks, CTR, CPC and orders should read “not available for Blinkit” in cross-platform views.

G6Restatement window too short

Sales change for 7 days; nothing changed 8+ days back. Today's setting is 5 days; propose 10.

G7Values the loader rejects

Match Type NA and SMART stop a load; spend floats need rounding to 2 decimals.

G8Dashboard export: not loadable as is

DD-MM-YYYY dates, category rows inside PRODUCT_LISTING, no Manufacturer column. Same numbers as the MTD report when settled: never feed both.

G9Mapping doc updated

docs/unified-db/11-mapping-blinkit.md now carries these findings and a phase-3 checklist (§7).
